result.description: The AuroraFlux Boreal 27 is a fictional 27-inch QHD studio monitor designed for color-critical desktop work, with a matte IPS panel, 10-bit processing, USB-C video input, and an integrated KVM switch for dual-system workflows. It targets graphic designers, illustrators, and remote professionals who want a clean, modern display with wide viewing angles, low blue-light modes, and factory-calibrated color settings. This monitor emphasizes workspace versatility rather than gaming or storage performance.
